items.title: The Real Price of Marvell Stock's Growth
items.summary: If you hold Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock, you’ve seen its price fluctuate. The company is posting strong growth, raising its revenue outlook for next year by $1.5 billion in a single quarter. Yet the stock is well off its highs, and it recently dropped even after reporting those results. This isn't a contradiction; it’s a signal that the market is focused on a new, more complicated question. The central risk for Marvell isn't that its AI-driven growth will stop.
